SUMMARY SHEET
Status: Final Environmental Statement
Subject: Penn-Susquehanna Urban Renewal
Project, Harrisburg, Pennsylvania
Name of Responsible Federal Agency:
Department of Housing and Urban Development Scranton Special Recovery Office Lackawanna County Building Spruce and Adams Avenue Scranton, Pa. 18503
I. Name of Actions: Administrative
II. Brief Description of Action
The action involves the approval and funding of an Urban Renewal Program under Title I of the Housing Act of 1949, as amended. The Federal capital grant will amount to 4,110,484 cver a five year period. (approved June 29, 1973).
The project will be administered by the Redevelopment Authority of Harrisburg and the activities that will be carried out are as follows:
a. Acquire property remove structures, construct site improvements and dispose of acquired property for redevelopment.
b. General redevelopment of the area.
c. Vacate, redesign, widen, or improve existing streets and alleys.
d. Reconstruct certain utilities.
e. Emphasize adequate off-street parking and loading areas.
f. Flood plain conservation measures to reduce the possibility of future loss.
g. Eliminate non-conforming land use.
h. Relocation of individuals and families displaced by the above operations.
i. Rehabilitation of project structures.
